decisions.reason: The abstract describes Batten disease as 'a family of rare, lysosomal disorders' caused by mutations in genes encoding lysosomal and extralysosomal proteins. The term 'lysosomal disorders' establishes dysfunction of the lysosome as the fundamental characteristic of the disease. Combined with the abstract's discussion of how mutations in Batten disease genes affect lysosomal function and contribute to disease etiology, this clearly establishes lysosomal dysfunction as a core mechanism of Batten disease. The relationship is not stated with the exact phrase 'has_mechanism' but is sufficiently established through the descriptive characterization of the disease and its molecular basis.
